Simple average EV/EBITDA (forward 12-month adjusted EBITDA) of AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile at end-2030.

Will bidding in the FCC upper C-band auction conclude by 31 December 2027?
resolution: Yes if the FCC announces the close of bidding (clock and assignment phases) of Auction 115 by 31 Dec 2027.

question: Will the upper C-band auction clear above the lower C-band's price of about $0.94 per MHz-pop?
resolution: Yes if Auction 115 gross bids divided by (MHz offered x 335M pops) exceed $0.94 and bidding concludes by 31 Dec 2028; No otherwise.

question: Will SpaceX win licences in the upper C-band auction?
resolution: Yes if SpaceX or an affiliate is a winning bidder in Auction 115 by 31 Dec 2028.

question: Will SpaceX's purchase of EchoStar's AWS-4 and H-block licences close by the end of 2027?
resolution: Yes if the licence assignment is consummated (not just approved) by 31 Dec 2027.

question: Will the FCC approve SpaceX's purchase of Grain's 800 MHz licences by the end of 2027?
resolution: Yes if the FCC grants the assignment applications (with or without conditions) by 31 Dec 2027.

question: Will SpaceX sell US mobile phone service under its own brand on its own spectrum by the end of 2028?
resolution: Yes if SpaceX/Starlink offers a paid US consumer mobile plan billed by SpaceX that uses SpaceX-owned spectrum (satellite, terrestrial or both) by 31 Dec 2028.

question: Will SpaceX be one of the four largest US mobile operators by subscribers by 2035?
resolution: Yes if SpaceX's directly billed US mobile subscribers exceed those of the fourth-largest of AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, Charter and Comcast at end-2035.

question: Will SpaceX, Amazon or another non-telecom tech company agree to buy a US facilities-based mobile carrier or a cable company's mobile business by 2030?
resolution: Yes if such a definitive agreement is announced by 31 Dec 2030.

question: Will US wireless revenue per GB rise year on year in any year from 2027 to 2030, a sign of a capacity crunch?
resolution: Yes if CTIA-basis service revenue per GB of traffic is higher than the prior year for any of 2027, 2028, 2029 or 2030.

question: Will US mobile data traffic grow more than 25% in any year from 2027 to 2030?
resolution: Yes if CTIA-reported annual traffic growth exceeds 25% for any of 2027-2030.

question: Will a US carrier launch commercial 3GPP 6G service by the end of 2030?
resolution: Yes if any US carrier offers paid commercial service on 3GPP Release 21 (6G) radio by 31 Dec 2030.

question: Will the FCC finish auctioning any upper mid-band spectrum above 4.2 GHz (such as 7.125-7.4 GHz) by the end of 2030?
resolution: Yes if bidding concludes by 31 Dec 2030 in an FCC auction of licensed mobile spectrum between 4.2 and 10.5 GHz.

question: Will at least one of Anterix, NextNav, Array or EchoStar's remaining licences be sold to a strategic buyer by the end of 2028?
resolution: Yes if a definitive agreement is announced by 31 Dec 2028 to sell the company or most of its spectrum (for EchoStar, its remaining licences) to an operator, satellite company or other strategic buyer.

question: Will an equal-weight basket of AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile beat the S&P 500 on total return from 19 November 2026 to the end of 2030?
resolution: Yes if the basket's total return (dividends reinvested) exceeds the S&P 500 total return over the period.
